intro_html: Sizzling fajita flavor without the restaurant markup, built on lean ground turkey and rice. You get 43 grams of protein per bowl for about $3.75 (at everyday cost), and the whole thing makes 14 servings. That is a taco-night craving satisfied for less than a fast-food value meal.
cost_closing_html: About $3.75 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Every one of the 14 bowls carries 43 grams of protein at just 544 calories, which keeps this one lean and filling.
upsell_html: Fajita night, meal-prepped and paid off. Your future self is going to thank you at noon. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Green bell peppers are usually the cheapest color in the bin, so grab those over red or yellow and pocket the difference.
A tub of light cream cheese adds the creamy richness without the fat, and one block stretches across the whole batch.
Buy dry rice by the pound instead of the instant pouches. It cooks in the same time and costs a fraction as much.
make_it: Brown 6.1 pounds of 93/7 ground turkey with the sliced onions and green bell peppers.
Cook the rice separately so it stays fluffy and portions clean.
Stir in the tomato paste, salsa verde, and cream cheese until the turkey turns saucy and coats everything.
Let it simmer a few minutes so the flavors pull together.
Spoon the fajita turkey over the rice in each container.
